titleEn: Upgrade, downgrade, cancel or resume subscription

undo.note: resume before period end; downgrade effects not undoable instantly

ar: لو نزلت الباقة هيحصل ايه للمنتجات؟
en: How do I upgrade my plan?
What happens to my data if I downgrade?

edgeCases: Plan downgrade mid-task: features gated on next call, staff over maxStaff, orders over monthly cap (Basic 300/mo)
Store over maxProducts on a Pro-limited plan
Cancellation keeps access until period end
Business plan has 3 stores max, downgrade with 2 stores refused (inferred)
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
assistantNote: show the feature-loss list in the preview
